title: Over 157M expected to shop in stores, online on Super Saturday

facts.fact: According to the NRF and Prosper Insights & Analytics annual survey, about 157.2 million people were expected to do holiday shopping in stores, online, or both on the final Saturday before Christmas.
facts.quote: About 157.2 million people are expected to do holiday shopping in stores, online or both this weekend on the final Saturday before Christmas

facts.fact: In the NRF/Prosper survey, 44% of those polled planned to shop both in-store and online, up from 41% the prior year.
facts.quote: The survey found that 44% of those polled plan to shop both in-store and online, up from 41% last year.

facts.fact: In the NRF/Prosper survey, 31% of respondents expected to shop exclusively in-store, down from 37% the prior year.
facts.quote: About 31% expect to shop exclusively in-store, down from 37% last year

facts.fact: In the NRF/Prosper survey, 37% of people with at least half their shopping left said they were still figuring out what to buy.
facts.quote: Thirty-seven percent of people with at least half of their shopping left to do said they were still figuring out what to buy

facts.fact: In the NRF/Prosper survey, 27% of people with at least half their shopping left reported having other financial priorities before December.
facts.quote: while 27% reported having other financial priorities before December.

facts.fact: In the NRF/Prosper survey, 24% of people with shopping left said they were still waiting on family or friends to tell them what gifts they wanted.
facts.quote: Twenty-four percent said they were still waiting on family or friends to tell them what gifts they wanted.

facts.fact: Per NRF data cited by Retail Dive, half of those with shopping left to finish planned to do so online.
facts.quote: According to the NRF, half of those with shopping to finish will do so online, while 37% will head to department stores.

facts.fact: Per NRF data cited by Retail Dive, 37% of those with shopping left to finish planned to visit department stores.
facts.quote: while 37% will head to department stores.

facts.fact: In the NRF/Prosper survey, 27% of shoppers planned to go to a discount store to finish their shopping.
facts.quote: 37% will visit department stores, 27% will go to a discount store

facts.fact: According to Prosper's executive vice president, over half of consumers expected to complete their shopping in the week leading up to Christmas.
facts.quote: over half of consumers expect they will complete their shopping in the week leading up to the Christmas holiday.
